review:
Frenzy Clusters lets you choose one of five heroes before you start, each sending you on a different adventure. It's a cluster-pays game with two unique bonus games.

Winning combinations can unlock rock symbols that extend the playing field for a spin; in the bonus, rocks can clear to reveal three random multipliers and expand the field until the round ends. Three bonus buy options are available where permitted, including a Mystery round that sends you into a random bonus mode. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97.11% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 269 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.11% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
